name: teams
title: Microsoft Teams
description: Channel conversations in Microsoft Teams. Connect Microsoft first, then pick the channels this source reads. Work or school accounts only — the Teams message APIs do not support personal Microsoft accounts.

channels.label: Channels
channels.hint: Pick from the teams you have joined, or type '{team id}/{channel id}' one per line. Both ids are needed: Graph reaches a channel only through its team, and a channel id is not unique across teams.
